name: pencilkit
title: PencilKit
description: Pressure-aware freehand drawing (perfect-freehand): PencilCanvas on its own or as a Canvas's drawing layer, the PencilKit tool palette (tools, inks, widths, undo/redo) on the kit Toolbar that folds to fit a phone, snapshot undo history, and the ImageAnnotator lightbox that marks up an image and saves it flattened.
